glosses: stop; bus stop (a place where buses, trams or trains halt to let passengers get on and off)

examples.text: No tenemos idea de su paradero.
examples.en: We have no idea about his whereabouts.

examples.text: Todavía no se conoce el paradero del sospechoso.
examples.en: The whereabouts of the suspect is still unknown.

examples.text: Quisiera saber el paradero de Tom.
examples.en: I'd like to know Tom's whereabouts.
We couldn't find out her whereabouts.

examples.text: Tom se quedó dormido en el bus y se pasó su paradero.
examples.en: Tom fell asleep on the bus and missed his stop.
